decision_document: AgroVision AI 2.0 Final Release Acceptance Decision
justification: The software application, database layer, adaptive questionnaire, evidence fusion engine, knowledge base, and yield forecasting models are fully integrated, operationally stable, and 100% verified across regression tests. However, the disease diagnosis neural model exhibits known cross-crop confusion (38.15% when unconditioned) and laboratory domain degradation (30.81%). It achieves high clinical accuracy (86.86% field accuracy, 91.33% accepted accuracy) ONLY under two mandatory operational constraints: (1) mandatory crop species confirmation by the user in the UI, and (2) active calibrated rejection gating at tau = 0.50. Therefore, the release is approved strictly under controlled pilot conditions with these active limitations.
operational_conditions_for_release: CONDITION-1: Mandatory Crop Selection — The web UI must require the farmer to select or confirm the crop species prior to final diagnostic commitment. Bypassing crop selection to rely purely on unconstrained 72-class argmax is prohibited.

CONDITION-2: Calibrated Rejection Gating — The confidence threshold tau = 0.50 must remain strictly active. Diagnoses with confidence below tau must trigger safe abstention (multiple_candidates or abstained_low_confidence).

CONDITION-3: Chemical Treatment Gating — Chemical pesticide recommendations must remain strictly locked whenever diagnosis decision status is anything other than diagnosis_supported or single_candidate_confirmed.

CONDITION-4: Environment Credential Rotation — Hardcoded database fallback credentials in backend/app/database.py must be removed and database password rotated before publicly exposing network endpoints.
CONDITION-5: Containerized Linux Deployment — Live deployment must utilize Linux containers (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Docker) to ensure unrestricted C++ tensor library runtime execution.
